Content Calendar Builder

Pick the brand, choose the month (or months), add the posts. The slide on the right is the deliverable: download it as an editable PowerPoint or a PNG.

Brand

Add a post

Platforms

To build a whole happening at once, switch the list below to "By happening": each happening gets its own quick-add row.

Paste many posts at once

One post per line, copied straight from Excel (tabs) or typed with commas. Columns: Date, Title, Type, Objective, Happening, Platforms, Project. Only the date and title are required; a first line with headings is understood. Platforms can be several, like IG FB LI. Dates like 14, 14/10/2026 or 2026-10-14 all work.

Posts on this slide

Show
Happenings, content types, objectives, projects

These lists feed the dropdowns above. Add a new one when you need it; remove one with ×. Happenings carry the colour you see on the slide.

Platform icons

Upload each platform's official icon (PNG or SVG, square works best) and it replaces the lettered badge on the slide and in the PowerPoint.

Back up or import a calendar

Calendars are saved for the whole team automatically. Use this only to keep an offline copy or to bring in a calendar from the standalone file.

The PowerPoint keeps every cell and post as editable shapes and text. With 2 or 3 months selected, the download also adds one detailed slide per month.
